prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a bustling pottery workshop. On the left, a woman in a blue apron sits on a wooden stool, her hands covered in wet gray clay as she shapes a spinning wheel. Next to her stands a tall man in a striped shirt, pointing at the emerging vase with his index finger. A small child in yellow overalls looks at the spinning clay with wide eyes, standing close to the man’s leg. In the center, an elderly man with white hair holds a finished ceramic bowl, examining its glaze under the bright overhead lights. Beside him, a young woman in a green dress is handing a sponge to a boy in a red cap who reaches out eagerly. A black cat sleeps on a shelf above them, curled into a tight ball near a stack of empty plates. To the right, a girl in a pink sweater kneels on the floor, painting intricate designs on a large jar with a fine brush. Behind her, a man in a leather vest leans against a workbench, watching her progress with a slight smile. A brown dog lies on the rug near the entrance, resting its head on its paws while observing the room. A rack of drying pots stands next to the girl, filled with various unfinished shapes. A bucket of soapy water sits on the floor near the woman in the blue apron, reflecting the ambient light. A towel hangs from the shoulder of the man in the striped shirt, slightly damp from use. A pair of glasses rests on the workbench near the elderly man, forgotten in the creative rush. There is no digital screen visible anywhere in the scene. There is no modern electronic device present in the workshop.
